article.title: Ulm5 — Germany’s show trial sets a dangerous precedent
article.author: Editor
article.content: In a show-trial riddled with procedural irregularities, Germany is seeking to make an example of five activists who organized against the genocide in Gaza. The post Ulm5 — Germany’s show trial sets a dangerous precedent appeared first on MR Online .
